decision.explanation: All four candidates are explicitly supported by direct textual evidence from the original sources. D1S15 confirms 'General Secretary of the Prefecture of Orne' as a current position. D1S10 supports 'Deputy Mayor of Oslo' as a former position. D1S12 supports 'Director of International Relations at the French Ministry of the Interior' as a former position. D2S1 and related sentences confirm 'deputy member of the Parliament of Norway' as a current or recently confirmed position. There is no contradiction among these claims, and each refers to a distinct role held by Atle Simonsen at different times or in different jurisdictions.
